requirement: Implement EPIC-2 story 2.2: expose the proven reduce() engine through a localhost-only FastAPI POST /reduce endpoint.

architecture.decision: Keep reduce() as the single reduction interface and call it with FastAPI's thread-pool helper from a multipart endpoint; the server entry point binds 127.0.0.1 and permits only local Vite origins.
alternatives: Invoke the reduce.py CLI as a subprocess
Build the full file/YouTube ingest layer in this story
tradeoffs: An in-process thread preserves the locked reduce() seam and keeps the async server responsive, but a CPU-heavy reduction still shares the sidecar process.
This story accepts uploaded files and cleanly rejects YouTube requests until story 2.3 owns URL download and full ingest validation.

tasks.title: Expose reduce over localhost
tasks.intent: Add the FastAPI application, multipart contract, validation, thread-worker execution, clean error mapping, local CORS, and localhost-only executable entry point.
constraints: Keep reduce() as the only engine interface

tasks.result: Added sidecar/app.py with multipart validation, bounded temporary uploads, thread-pooled reduce(), clean 400/413/422 errors, local Vite CORS, and a 127.0.0.1-only uvicorn entry point.
